author: studio.marta
hook: Your cold email is too long. Three lines. That's it.
title: Cold email that gets replies: the 3-line structure
one_liner: Why short cold emails outperform long ones, with a template you can copy.
key_points: Line 1: one specific observation about them, not about you
Line 2: the one thing you do, in plain words, no adjectives
Line 3: a yes/no question — no calendar link in the first email

author: ben.builds
hook: One serif. One sans. One weight change.
title: Type pairing rule for landing pages
one_liner: A 40-second rule for pairing fonts so a page looks designed, not assembled.
key_points: Display serif for headings only; body in a plain sans at 16–18 px
Line height 1.5 for body, 1.1 for headings
For emphasis change weight, not family

author: kitchen.tomas
hook: Weeknight pasta with no cream and one pan.
title: 20-minute miso butter pasta
one_liner: Miso + butter + starchy pasta water makes a glossy sauce with no cream.
key_points: 1 tbsp white miso + 2 tbsp butter per 200 g pasta
Emulsify with a ladle of pasta water, off the heat
Finish with lemon zest and black pepper
